messages:
pagerduty: PD ALERT: edge-frontend-tls-errors (P1) triggered by synthetic canaries failing TLS handshake in ap-southeast-2 and eu-central-1. Auto-page from incident-bot.
incident-bot: page fired (runbook: network/lb-tls) - incident id pd_2026_00456. This thread will capture mitigation steps.
jess: acked on PD, Im the primary oncall. Noted canaries down ~23:05 UTC. Pulling logs.
mark: canaries show repeated `tls: handshake failure` from envoy edge-proxies. Sample from envoy: ```[envoy][2026-07-18T23:05:12Z] TLS Alert: handshake_failure (40)``` — spikes correlate with a config push at ~23:00.
luis: I see a listener config rollout at 22:59:53 UTC that swapped listeners to new cert ARN arn:aws:acm:...:cert/new-arn without chain. Cert-rotator job ran at 22:58:10 and returned success.
jess: confirm whether this was a global rollout or targeted to regions?
mark: rollout targeted a subset: ap-southeast-2 and eu-central-1 were included in the initial wave; us-west-2 and eu-west-1 were excluded. That matches impacted regions.
incident-bot: suggested mitigation steps: 1) scale down new listener weight 2) reattach previous cert bundle 3) relax TLS policy to allow 1.2 as temporary fallback. Use /incident note to update.
jess: initiating immediate mitigation: reducing new-listener weight in ap-southeast-2 and eu-central-1 via netctl: ```netctl listener set-weight --env prod --listener new-listener --weight 0.0 --region ap-southeast-2``` — executing now.
luis: while you do that I'm pulling ALB metrics and route53 change history. No Route53 changes at 22:58-23:06, so not DNS. Logs show ALB returning 526 SSL handshake error upstream.
mark: validating cert chain locally: `openssl s_client -connect edge.example.com:443 -showcerts` shows server not sending intermediate CA in the chain for the new cert. Old certs include the full chain.
jess: rolling back listener to previous cert ARN in affected regions. Command: ```aws elbv2 modify-listener --listener-arn arn:aws:elb:... --certificates CertificateArn=arn:aws:acm:old-arn --ssl-policy ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS-1-2-2017-01``` — doing ap-southeast-2 first.
incident-bot: note: pagerduty escalation level increased to SRE lead if unresolved in 15m.
kai: joining — looking at proxy config; envoy on edge nodes had TLS protocol enforcement set to TLS1.3 only due to a linted security policy change in the repo earlier today. That plus missing intermediate explains failures for clients negotiating TLS1.2.
jess: for fast rollback: mark please attach the full chain bundle to ACM and reattach to listener; luis please apply temporary TLS policy allowing 1.2.
luis: uploaded chain bundle and reimported cert (new ARN: arn:aws:acm:...:cert/with-chain). Re-attaching to listener now. Also applied TLS policy change: ```aws elbv2 modify-listener --listener-arn ... --ssl-policies ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS-1-2-2017-01```.
mark: weight shift complete in ap-southeast-2, certificate reattached and ALB policy relaxed. Handing eu-central-1 next.
jess: monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/edge/tls-handshake?from=now-1h shows canary successes climbing back. Canary pass rate: ap-southeast-2 98% -> 99% within 90s; eu-central-1 showing similar trend.
kai: confirming that the cert-rotator job did not include intermediate in the export step (bug in packaging). Opening quick PR to add chain file to artifacts.
incident-bot: actions recorded: [rollback cert] [reimport with chain] [apply TLS1.2 fallback] [weight shift] [lower DNS TTLs if needed].
jess: support comms draft: "We observed intermittent TLS handshake failures for some API traffic in AP-SOUTHEAST-2 and EU-CENTRAL-1 between 23:00 and 23:20 UTC due to a certificate bundle missing its intermediate CA following an automated rotation. Traffic was rerouted and previous certificates restored; services recovered by ~23:12 UTC. A postmortem will follow." Please review support.
support: thanks, please include list of affected customer org IDs and a short timeline. Ill prepare the message.
luis: ALB target health checks are green now. Envoy logs: "TLS handshake complete" repeating. No more 526.
jess: PD ack duration: 8m to first mitigation action. PD escalation canceled now.
incident-bot: incident status set to mitigated by jess at 23:15 UTC. Please run /incident close after postmortem link is attached.
pagerduty: incident cleared on PagerDuty at 23:16 UTC. Page duration 11m.
kai: post-incident follow-ups: - add intermediate chain verification to cert-rotator CI - add pre-rollout canary that validates TLS handshake from each region - revert TLS1.3-only enforcement until we validate clients.
jess: I will stay on for one more handoff to mark at 00:30 UTC. Mark will own follow-ups.
mark: creating INC-2026-344 ticket and assigning to eng-runtime and infra-team for remediation and postmortem.
support: customer-facing note scheduled for 23:40 UTC.
incident-bot: thread archived. Use /incident reopen if regressions occur."
